articles.title: Rejected Lover Behind Fake Bomb Threats to Puri Jagannath Temple, Habitual Offender Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Puri police have arrested a man for allegedly creating a fake Facebook account and posting threatening messages about a bomb attack on the Lord Jagannath Temple, triggering panic and security concerns.

body.html:
Puri police have arrested a man for allegedly creating a fake Facebook account and posting threatening messages about a bomb attack on the Lord Jagannath Temple, triggering panic and security concerns.

The accused has been identified as Pratik Mishra (30), also referred to as Prateek Mishra, who was arrested by Singhadwar police following a complaint by the Shree Jagannath Temple Administration (SJTA). The case pertains to threatening posts on social media warning of a bomb blast at the 12th-century Shrimandir and threats against BJD Rajya Sabha MP Subhasish Khuntia and a shopping complex in Puri.

According to police, Mishra was romantically interested in a woman named Julirani Panda. After she repeatedly rejected his proposals, he allegedly hatched a conspiracy to defame her. Investigators said Mishra used the woman’s SIM card without her knowledge to create a fake Facebook account in her name on April 11. Using this account, he posted alarming messages threatening to blow up the Jagannath Temple and shoot MP Subhasish Khuntia.

The posts went viral on social media on Monday, following which MP Subhasish Khuntia lodged a formal complaint. Acting on the complaint, the Puri Cyber Police traced the posts and arrested Mishra.

Police further revealed that the account initially appeared to belong to a woman, but technical investigation confirmed it was operated by Mishra after his love proposal was rejected. Senior Superintendent of Police (Puri) Prateek Singh said the motive behind the act was revenge.

During the investigation, police found that Mishra is a habitual offender with a long criminal record. He has been booked in at least nine cases over the past decade, including charges of attempt to murder, theft, cheating, forgery, extortion, cyber defamation, molestation and sexual assault. Cases against him were registered at Puri Town, Balanga, Kendrapada Sadar and Patkura police stations between 2016 and 2025.

Police sources said Mishra was also arrested in April 2025 by Patkura police in Kendrapada district in an extortion and abetment to su***de case. In that incident, a man died by s**de after a false rape case was allegedly fabricated by Mishra and two others, who then demanded ₹1 lakh to withdraw the complaint. He was also accused of defaming two teachers in the Balanga area in 2019 by morphing their photographs.

Police have intensified the investigation and are examining whether the accused acted alone or had any accomplices.

articles.title: Birthday Gunshot Exposes ‘Honeytrap Queen’: 150 Victims, 12 Cops on Blackmail List in Gorakhpur
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A sensational case has emerged from Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, where a woman accused of firing at a private hospital manager during her birthday celebration has been found to be allegedly running an organised blackmail and extortion racket for years.

body.html:
A sensational case has emerged from Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, where a woman accused of firing at a private hospital manager during her birthday celebration has been found to be allegedly running an organised blackmail and extortion racket for years. Police claim the accused trapped nearly 150 people, including at least 12 police personnel, by recording obscene video calls and threatening them with false rape cases.

The accused has been identified as Anshika Singh alias Antima, a resident of Jhudia Babu village in the Harpur-Budhat area. According to police sources, obscene videos and chats recovered from her mobile phone revealed details of large-scale extortion. During interrogation, Anshika allegedly confessed that she contacted people through social media and messaging apps, established intimacy via video calls, recorded them, and later demanded money.

Police say that over the last five years, Anshika contacted around 150 people, including ordinary citizens, politicians and police officers. Among those allegedly targeted are more than 12 policemen, including a Circle Officer currently posted in Ayodhya and a station in-charge of Geeta police station. Investigators also found that she recently demanded money from a sub-inspector posted at Gida police station, with the matter allegedly settled after a five-hour meeting involving cash and a gold chain.

The matter came to light after a firing incident on January 20 near a model shop at Singhadia intersection, under Cantt police station limits. Anshika was celebrating her birthday with friends when she reportedly got into an argument with Vishal Mishra, manager of a private hospital. Police say she demanded extortion money from Vishal and, during a scuffle, fired a pistol. The bullet hit Vishal’s friend Amitabh in the stomach. He is currently undergoing treatment at a private hospital.

Based on Vishal Mishra’s complaint, police arrested Anshika Singh and her accomplice Bunty alias Akash Verma, a resident of Barhaj in Deoria district, and sent them to jail. Four to five other accused are absconding, and police teams are searching for them.

The investigation has also brought to light Anshika’s past criminal record. In 2021, she lodged an FIR against a man from Deoria under rape, threat and POCSO charges, allegedly extorting lakhs of rupees later in the name of settlement. In 2023, she lived in a rented house in Khalilabad, Sant Kabir Nagar, where the landlord complained to the Superintendent of Police after noticing suspicious activities. She allegedly demanded ₹2 lakh from the landlord before vacating the premises.

Police records further show that Anshika had filed multiple cases under the POCSO Act and rape sections against different individuals, later entering into settlements. In one case, she allegedly extorted ₹50,000 each from two men by threatening to implicate them in false cases. Complaints related to these incidents were also submitted on the Chief Minister’s portal.

City Superintendent of Police Abhinav Tyagi said a case has been registered under serious sections, including attempt to murder, extortion and criminal conspiracy. “The investigation is ongoing. Action will be taken against all accused based on mobile data, video recordings, call details and financial transactions,” said Yogendra Singh, CO Cantt.

Police say the case highlights the dangers of blind trust on social media, as the accused allegedly used fake profiles to trap victims before blackmailing them.

articles.title: Express Train Hits Truck at Railway Crossing in Jharkhand, Major Accident Averted
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A major rail accident was narrowly avoided on Thursday (22 January 2026) morning when the Gonda–Asansol Express collided with a rice-laden truck at a railway crossing in Jharkhand.

body.html:
A major rail accident was narrowly avoided on Thursday (22 January 2026) morning when the Gonda–Asansol Express collided with a rice-laden truck at a railway crossing in Jharkhand. The incident occurred at the Rohini–Nawadih railway crossing between Jasidih and Madhupur, under the Deoghar–Madhupur section, around 9:38 am.

According to railway officials, train number 13510, travelling from Gonda to Asansol, struck a truck bearing registration number JH15X-8874 while it was crossing the tracks on the down line. The collision led to temporary disruption of train services on both the up and down lines.

Railway authorities restored movement on the up line at around 10:55 am, following which the Asansol–Jhajha passenger train was allowed to pass cautiously through the affected section.

A video of the incident has surfaced on social media, showing the moment the train hit the truck. Eyewitnesses said there was heavy vehicular movement at the crossing at the time of the accident. Gatekeeper Pankaj Kumar stated that due to congestion at the crossing, the train was not supposed to be given a signal. However, the express train arrived on the down line and collided with the truck, triggering panic in the area.

During the impact, the truck also hit two motorcycles that were crossing the tracks. The riders managed to escape in time, and no injuries or casualties have been reported so far.

Railway officials, Railway Protection Force (RPF) personnel and local police rushed to the spot, controlled the situation and initiated clearance work. Railway authorities have ordered an inquiry into the incident to examine gate operations, signalling arrangements and possible negligence on the part of the truck driver.

articles.title: Wedding Talks Turn Deadly: Man Set to Marry 21-Year-Old Paramedic Kills Her, Calls Police Himself
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The Dharwad Rural Police have solved the murder of a 21-year-old paramedical student whose body was found near a dairy on Mansur Road, on the outskirts of Dharwad. In a shocking revelation, police said the accused is a relative of the victim and the man who was expected to marry her.

body.html:
The Dharwad Rural Police have solved the murder of a 21-year-old paramedical student whose body was found near a dairy on Mansur Road, on the outskirts of Dharwad. In a shocking revelation, police said the accused is a relative of the victim and the man who was expected to marry her.

The victim, Zakia Mulla (21), a resident of Gandhi Chowk in Dharwad, was found dead near the Vinay Kulkarni dairy within the limits of Vidyagiri Police Station. Police confirmed that she was strangled to death using her own veil following an argument over marriage.

Zakia had recently completed her paramedical studies and was actively searching for a job. According to her family, she was focused on building her career and supporting her household.

On the evening of January 20, Zakia left her home stating that she was going to a laboratory for work-related purposes. When she failed to return even late at night, her worried parents began searching for her and alerted the police. Her mobile phone location last showed Mansur Road.

The next morning, her body was found in a secluded spot near the dairy. Senior police officers, along with the Scene of Crime Officers (SOCO) team, rushed to the spot, sealed the area and collected forensic evidence. Preliminary examination suggested death by strangulation, and police initially suspected that the murder had taken place elsewhere and the body was later dumped.

In a startling development, police revealed that the accused, Sabir Mulla, was present near the spot where the body was found. He himself called the District Superintendent of Police and informed him about the murder. Even after police arrived, Sabir remained at the scene and pretended to be unaware of the crime.

However, his unusual behaviour and nervousness raised suspicion. He was taken into custody for questioning, during which he reportedly confessed to the crime.

According to police, Zakia and Sabir, who are relatives, had gone out together on the evening of January 20. During their time together, an argument broke out over their proposed marriage. As the quarrel escalated, Sabir allegedly lost control and strangled Zakia to death using her veil.

A senior police officer said, “Prima facie, it is a clear case of death by strangulation. The accused has admitted to the act during interrogation.”

Zakia’s father, Yunus Mulla, told the media that marriage discussions had taken place through a family friend but no formal engagement had been finalised. He said his daughter never expressed any fear or distress before leaving home. “She wanted to work and stand on her own feet,” he said.

Police have arrested Sabir Mulla and produced him before the court. Another young man is also being questioned to ascertain whether anyone else was involved in the crime or in attempting to mislead investigators.

After the post-mortem examination, Zakia’s body was handed over to her family in the presence of police officials. A case has been registered at the Dharwad Rural Police Station, and further investigation is underway.

The murder has sent shockwaves through Gandhi Chowk and nearby areas, with residents expressing fear and anguish, particularly for the safety of young women.

articles.title: ₹40,000 Bribe Trap Exposes Power Department Corruption, Junior Engineer Arrested in Agra
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A junior engineer and a contract worker were arrested on Wednesday (21 Jan 2026) evening by an anti-corruption team from Agra for allegedly accepting a bribe of ₹40,000 in exchange for dropping a case of electricity theft.

body.html:
A junior engineer and a contract worker were arrested on Wednesday (21 Jan 2026) evening by an anti-corruption team from Agra for allegedly accepting a bribe of ₹40,000 in exchange for dropping a case of electricity theft. Both accused will be produced before a departmental court in Agra on Thursday. The incident has created a stir within the power department.

According to officials, Neeraj Kumar, a resident of Naushera village, had lodged a complaint with the anti-corruption unit alleging that Junior Engineer Rajesh Pal, posted at the Naushera feeder, was demanding a bribe of ₹70,000 from him. Neeraj informed the team that an electricity theft case had earlier been registered against him, for which the department had imposed a settlement fee of ₹21,000.

The complainant alleged that despite the settlement, the junior engineer demanded additional money to close the case. When Neeraj pleaded for a reduction, the engineer allegedly agreed to take ₹40,000 immediately and the remaining amount later. After verifying the complaint, the anti-corruption team laid a trap.

Following the team’s instructions, Neeraj agreed to pay the bribe. On Wednesday evening around 4:30 pm, during a one-time settlement scheme camp in Bhura Bharathara, the accused were caught red-handed while accepting the money.

Inspector Sanjay Rai, who led the operation, said Junior Engineer Rajesh Pal, a resident of Mainpuri city, and contract worker Jayaprakash alias Munish Pal of Prithvipur, Karhal (Mainpuri), were apprehended at the Mata Mandir intersection in Bhura Bharathara.

Investigators revealed that the junior engineer initially called Neeraj to the Naushera feeder and later directed him to a nearby village and then to the intersection. As soon as the bribe amount was accepted at the spot, the anti-corruption team moved in and arrested both accused.

Further legal proceedings are underway.

articles.title: Job-Seeking Paramedical Student Found Murdered in Dharwad, Body Dumped on City Outskirts
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A brutal murder case has come to light in Dharwad, sending shockwaves across the district. A young paramedical student, who had left home to visit a lab, was found murdered and her body dumped on the outskirts of the city.

body.html:
A brutal murder case has come to light in Dharwad, sending shockwaves across the district. A young paramedical student, who had left home to visit a lab, was found murdered and her body dumped on the outskirts of the city.

The deceased has been identified as Zakia Mulla, daughter of Yunus Mulla, a resident of Gandhi Chowk, Dharwad. While initial reports described her as 19 years old, police later identified her age as 21. Zakia had completed her paramedical education and was actively searching for a job.

According to the police, Zakia left her house on Tuesday evening after informing her family that she was going to a lab. When she did not return home by night, her family members grew worried and began searching for her. Despite efforts throughout the night, they were unable to trace her.

Early Wednesday morning, Zakia’s body was found in a deserted area near Vinay Dairy on Mansur Road, on the outskirts of Dharwad. The location reportedly belongs to MLA Vinay Kulkarni. Police suspect that Zakia was murdered at another location and her body was later dumped at the spot in an attempt to destroy evidence.

Police teams from Dharwad Rural and Vidyagiri police stations rushed to the scene and carried out a preliminary inspection. The body was sent for post-mortem examination to ascertain the cause of death.

As news of the murder spread, Zakia’s parents and relatives rushed to the spot and broke down in grief. Expressing anger and anguish, family members said their daughter, who was only trying to secure a job, did not deserve such a fate. They have demanded the immediate arrest of the culprits and strict punishment.

Dharwad District Superintendent of Police Gunjan Arya said that Zakia had gone missing after leaving home on Tuesday afternoon. “Information was received early this morning by Dharwad City and Vidyagiri police stations. The body has now been found. Police personnel are collecting evidence, and the SOCO team is also inspecting the spot. Clear details will emerge after the post-mortem,” she said.

Police have registered a murder case and intensified the investigation. Call records from Zakia’s mobile phone are being examined to determine motive.

articles.title: Fare Dispute Turns Brutal: Bus Conductor Thrashes Woman on Road as Child Cries in Shivpuri
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking video of a woman being assaulted by a bus conductor during a fare dispute has gone viral from the Karaira police station area of Shivpuri district in Madhya Pradesh.

body.html:
A shocking video of a woman being assaulted by a bus conductor during a fare dispute has gone viral from the Karaira police station area of Shivpuri district in Madhya Pradesh.

According to reports, the incident involved a passenger bus of Sheetla Bus Service (registration number MP07 P 2072). The woman was travelling with her young child when an argument broke out with the conductor over the bus fare. The conductor, identified as Mahendra Rawat, a resident of Masoodpur, allegedly lost his temper during the dispute.

Eyewitnesses said the conductor threw the woman’s luggage out of the bus and forcefully pushed her onto the roadside. He then allegedly assaulted her in full public view and twisted her arm. The woman’s young child, visibly terrified, began crying during the incident. In the viral video, the child can be seen raising his hand in distress, as if trying to stop the conductor.

The woman later filed a complaint with the police. Meanwhile, a passerby recorded the incident and uploaded the video on social media, after which the matter drew widespread attention. Acting on the complaint and the viral footage, police have registered a criminal case against the accused conductor and initiated an investigation.

Notably, despite the presence of several passengers on the bus, none intervened or came forward to help the woman during the assault. Police are examining all aspects of the incident and recording statements of those present at the scene.

articles.title: Birthday Bash Turns Bloody: Woman Fires Pistol During Argument in Gorakhpur, Youth Shot
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A birthday celebration turned violent in Gorakhpur on Tuesday night after a young woman allegedly fired a pistol during an argument, leaving a youth seriously injured. The incident took place in the Singhadia area under the Cantonment police station limits.

body.html:
A birthday celebration turned violent in Gorakhpur on Tuesday night after a young woman allegedly fired a pistol during an argument, leaving a youth seriously injured. The incident took place in the Singhadia area under the Cantonment police station limits.

According to police, the accused, Anshika, a resident of Harpurbudhat, is currently living in a rented house in Singhadia. On Tuesday, January 20, she was celebrating her birthday with friends near a model shop in the area.

During the celebration, Vishal Mishra arrived at the spot along with his friends Amitabh Nishad, Shailesh and Sandeep. Police said Vishal approached Anshika upon seeing her, following which a heated argument broke out between the two.

Investigators said Vishal suspected that Anshika was regularly taking his wife out, an issue that had led to disputes between them in the past as well. The verbal altercation soon escalated into a physical scuffle. During the confrontation, Anshika allegedly pulled out a pistol, and a shot was fired amid the chaos.

The bullet hit Amitabh Nishad, one of Vishal’s companions, in the stomach. Panic gripped the area after the firing. Amitabh was rushed to a nearby hospital and later referred to a medical college for further treatment. He is a resident of Jungle Sikri Bypass under the Khorabar police station area and works as a driver for a nursing home manager.

After the incident, local residents apprehended Anshika and her companions and informed the police. Police detained Anshika, Vishal Mishra and another youth, and seized the pistol used in the firing.

CCTV footage from the surrounding area has been collected, and a case has been registered. Cantonment Circle Officer Yogendra Kumar Singh said Anshika was previously booked in a theft case at the Khorabar police station. Further investigation is underway to ascertain the exact sequence of events and the motive behind the firing.
